# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture and domain analysis artifacts generated during assessment.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md): Two-layer architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md): External dependency inventory grouped by modernization-relevant categories.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md): Service catalog, endpoint contracts, and service communication sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md): Database configuration, entity model, and persistence boundaries.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md): Runtime/build configuration sources, profiles, and sensitive settings inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md): Core domain workflows, business rules, and cross-flow sequence.
